component.name: Tempest 2032
component.summary: An arcade tube shooter with graphics for modern hardware

description.p: Tempest 2032 is a Tempest 2000 clone with graphics for modern hardware. Fight through 100 webs, collect weapon and movement upgrades, and fly through three kinds of warp-zone bonus stages.
Play with a keyboard or controller. All levels, sound effects, and music are included, so you can start playing immediately.

screenshot.caption: Level 8 with the wide V-shaped web, enemies, and explosion rings
